column3: “Separated” is rendered “set apart”; NASB supplies “some of” and “were to,” and the two stringed instruments are reversed. “Men of work” is rendered “those who performed.”
“On the hand of” is rendered “under the direction of.”
The Hebrew lists five sons but says “six”; NASB supplies “Shimei” from verse 17. “On the hands of” is rendered “under the direction of.”
“To lift up a horn” is rendered “to exalt him,” and NASB adds “for.”
“On the hands of” is rendered “under the direction of”; NASB supplies “to sing,” and the two stringed instruments are reversed.
“Every understanding person” is rendered “all who were skillful.”
“Duty correspondingly” is rendered “for their duties, all alike.”
The Hebrew does not count Joseph's group; NASB supplies “the second for” and joins the count “twelve” to Gedaliah.
